svg.title: P003 · Customers in metro cities
svg.desc: One row per customer in an eligible metro. ID 5 displays MUMBAI and matches on mumbai. Padding disappears from ID 12. Pune (ID 21) drops out. Bangalore, Bombay and New Delhi are accepted spellings in this exercise. Within Bengaluru, ID 7 precedes ID 12. The output keeps each trimmed display spelling. FROM Customers · one table is enough. The report lists people by their own city. One customer row supplies the city to test and the ID, name and state to display.
